extracted.intended_audience: patent owners and third-party requesters filing ex parte reexamination requests with the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: Checklist/transmittal form specifying required elements, certifications, attachments, payment, and service for filing a request for ex parte reexamination under 37 CFR 1.510 with the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing method and address
rubrics_metrics.description: File via the USPTO patent electronic filing system, or send to Mail Stop Ex Parte Reexam, Commissioner for Patents, P.O. Box 1450, Alexandria, VA 22313-1450.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send fees or completed forms to the Privacy Act address; use EFS or the specified Commissioner for Patents P.O. Box. Assistance by phone: 1-800-PTO-9199 option 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify patent to be reexamined
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a request for ex parte reexamination pursuant to 37 CFR 1.510 of patent number ______ issued ______.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the exact patent number and issue date of the patent for which reexamination is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requester identity and status (patent owner or third party)
rubrics_metrics.description: The requestor must indicate whether the request is made by the patent owner or a third party requester (with option for third party to remain anonymous under 35 U.S.C. 301(e) and 37 CFR 1.501(d)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not check box 2b if claiming anonymity. Provide name and address of the person requesting reexamination unless anonymous option is properly used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name and address of requester
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the name and address of the person requesting reexamination (unless anonymous third-party option properly asserted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full contact details; required unless third-party anonymity option is validly invoked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small entity / micro entity certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requester may assert small entity status (37 CFR 1.27) or certify micro entity status (37 CFR 1.29).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If certifying micro entity status, attach Form PTO/SB/15A or 15B (as applicable) to certify micro entity status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of reexamination fee and payment method
rubrics_metrics.description: Request must be accompanied by payment of the reexamination fee as set forth in 37 CFR 1.20(c)(2) or 37 CFR 1.20(c)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If checking box for 37 CFR 1.20(c)(1), requester asserts the request has forty (40) or fewer pages and complies with other requirements of that provision. Payment methods: check, charge to Deposit Account No., credit card (attach Form PTO-2038), or payment via the USPTO patent electronic filing system. Director may be authorized to charge fee deficiencies to a deposit account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refund instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify whether any refund should be made by check or credited to a Deposit Account Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under 37 CFR 1.26(c), if payment was by credit card, refund must be to the credit card account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of the patent in specified format
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the patent to be reexamined having a double column format on one side of a separate paper is enclosed (37 CFR 1.510(b)(4)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a separate paper copy formatted as specified (double column format on one side).

rubrics_metrics.name: Large attachments on electronic media
rubrics_metrics.description: If submitting a CD-ROM or CD-R in duplicate, a Computer Program (Appendix) or large table, indicate and provide landscape table on CD as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide duplicates where required and label media appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotide/amino acid sequence submissions requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, items a–c are required: a. Computer Readable Form (CRF); b. Specification Sequence Listing on CD-ROM (2 copies) or CD-R (2 copies) or paper; c. Statements verifying identity of above copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow sequence submission requirements and supply required number of copies and identity verification statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of disclaimers and correction certificates
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of any disclaimer, certificate of correction or reexamination certificate issued in the patent is included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include copies of any such documents present in the patent record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of claim(s) requested for reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Reexamination of claim(s) ______ is requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each claim number for which reexamination is sought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of every relied-upon patent or printed publication
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of every patent or printed publication relied upon is submitted herewith including a listing thereof on Form PTO/SB/08, PTO-1449, or equivalent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach complete copies of each cited reference and a listing on the specified form or equivalent; include English translations where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: English translations for non-English references
rubrics_metrics.description: An English language translation of all necessary and pertinent non-English language patents and/or printed publications is attached.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide translations of non-English references that are necessary and pertinent to the substantial new questions asserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed request contents — substantial new question(s) of patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: The attached detailed request includes at least: (a) A statement identifying each substantial new question of patentability based on prior patents and printed publications (37 CFR 1.510(b)(1)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state each substantial new question of patentability and tie it to the cited prior art (patents/printed publications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed request contents — claim identification and explanation of pertinency and application of cited art
rubrics_metrics.description: The attached detailed request includes: (b) An identification of every claim for which reexamination is requested, and a detailed explanation of the pertinency and manner of applying the cited art to every claim for which reexamination is requested (37 CFR 1.510(b)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each identified claim, provide a detailed explanation showing how each cited reference is pertinent and how it applies to that claim (manner of applying cited art).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed amendment (patent owner requester only)
rubrics_metrics.description: A proposed amendment is included (only where the patent owner is the requester) (37 CFR 1.510(e)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent owner requesters who propose claim amendments must include the proposed amendment with the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification regarding statutory estoppel
rubrics_metrics.description: It is certified that the statutory estoppel provisions of 35 U.S.C. 315(e)(1) or 35 U.S.C. 325(e)(1) do not prohibit requester from filing this ex parte reexamination request (37 CFR 1.510(b)(6)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requesters must affirm that applicable estoppel provisions do not bar the request; include certification on form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service requirement and certification
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 37 CFR 1.510(b)(5), it is certified that a copy of this request (if filed by other than the patent owner) has been served in its entirety on the patent owner at the address provided in 37 CFR 1.33(c), in a manner of service compliant with 37 CFR 1.248.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the name and address of the party served and the date of service. For non-patent owner filers, certify service was made in an acceptable manner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manner of service options (37 CFR 1.248)
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptable manners of service: delivering a copy to the person served; leaving a copy at usual place of business with someone in employment; leaving at residence with suitable person; transmission by first class mail (mailing date regarded as date of service).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and use an approved manner of service; when service is by mail the mailing date is the date of service.

rubrics_metrics.name: If service on patent owner not possible
rubrics_metrics.description: If service on the patent owner was not possible, an explanation of the efforts made to serve patent owner is attached. See MPEP 2220. A duplicate copy of the request is also attached, unless the request is filed using USPTO patent electronic filing system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document and attach evidence of attempts to serve and include duplicate copy where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence address and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide correspondence address: the address associated with Customer Number OR full address, city, state, zip, country, telephone, email, and firm or individual name for directing all communication about the reexamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designate the address to which USPTO should send all reexamination communications; include Customer Number if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of concurrent matters
rubrics_metrics.description: The patent is currently the subject of the following concurrent matters: copending reissue application no., copending reexamination control no., copending interference or PTAB trial no., copending litigation, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List any pending related proceedings (reissue, reexamination, PTAB trials/interferences, litigation) and provide additional sheets if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and credit card warning
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning: Information on this form may become public. Credit card information should not be included on this form. Provide credit card information and authorization on PTO-2038.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not put credit card numbers on the transmittal; use PTO-2038 for card payments/authorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized signature and filer identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Authorized signature, date, typed/printed name, and Registration No. (separate signature lines for Patent Owner Requester and Third Party Requester).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign and date the form; provide printed name and attorney/agent registration number where applicable to validate the filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act and burden estimate / assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB control number displayed; public burden estimate (average 55 hours per response) and contact for comments regarding burden reduction; DO NOT SEND FEES OR COMPLETED FORMS to the Privacy Act address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form displays OMB control number; notes estimated time burden and provides address/email for burden comments and phone assistance for completing the form.
